# Burnly v0.1.30

Attributes historical Antigravity usage without source timestamps to an undated
baseline on initial scan, and repairs profile-2 installations where historical
tokens were incorrectly attributed to Today.

## Highlights

- **Undated historical baseline attribution.** Historical Antigravity
  conversations across CLI, App, and IDE variants that omit native turn
  timestamps are now attributed to an undated baseline on first scan. They no
  longer inflate Today's daily token totals upon initial install or scan.
- **Post-baseline prompt attribution.** Genuinely new prompts executed after
  baseline scan completion continue to infer first-seen timestamps, contribute
  to daily usage for the active calendar day, and report partial data quality.
- **Automated profile-2 historical repair.** Existing installations upgraded
  from profile 2 automatically reclassify historical cache records to undated
  baselines, tombstone empty historical daily usage and sessions (`record_state = 'removed'`),
  and update local aggregates with full ledger audit proof.
- **Account-safe collect-sync tombstones.** Repaired date ranges are merged into
  `collect_sync_state` across all registered local accounts, ensuring subsequent
  cloud synchronization removes obsolete historical daily records without data
  loss or multi-account cross-contamination.
- **Resilient refresh orchestration.** Multi-stage repair coordination guarantees
  clean resumption across application restarts, cancellations, and transient
  storage errors without failing active refresh runs.

## Privacy

Burnly continues to read usage-only metadata. It selects model identity, token
counters, and generation timestamps; it never reads prompt text, response
content, tool invocations, project paths, or sensitive credentials.

## Install

### Linux

Run:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/latest/download/install-linux.sh | sh
```

For a pinned install of this release:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/download/v0.1.30/install-linux.sh | BURNLY_VERSION=v0.1.30 sh
```

### Windows Preview

Download the Windows x64 installer from this release:

```text
burnly-v0.1.30-windows-x86_64.exe
```

The Windows preview installer is not Authenticode-signed. Windows may show an
unknown publisher or SmartScreen warning. Only download Burnly from the
official GitHub release and verify the published `SHA256SUMS`. Tauri updater
artifacts remain cryptographically signed.

### macOS Preview

Run:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/latest/download/install-macos.sh | sh
```

For a pinned install of this release:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/fikrilal/burnly/releases/download/v0.1.30/install-macos.sh | BURNLY_VERSION=v0.1.30 sh
```

Manual `.dmg` installation is also available:

```text
burnly-v0.1.30-macos-aarch64.dmg
burnly-v0.1.30-macos-x86_64.dmg
```

The macOS preview is unsigned and not notarized. If Gatekeeper blocks the
downloaded app, clear quarantine once after copying it to Applications:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Burnly.app
```

## Verification

The baseline attribution and repair mechanisms were tested against all 10 target
scenarios: fresh install with CLI/App/IDE corpora, mixed timestamp streams,
post-baseline activity, profile-2 upgrades, multi-account sync, failure recovery,
interrupted baselines, and multi-stage resumability.

Release artifacts include `SHA256SUMS`, GitHub build provenance, signed updater
artifacts, `latest.json`, and the `latest-linux.json` compatibility alias.
